nativeValidation.setup: Run these commands from the root of a disposable checkout in non-elevated PowerShell. The test creates ordinary files in the checkout's temporary directory.
commands: if ((git rev-parse HEAD).Trim() -ne 'f192231ed52ab70854cde414b0ad1226e3d9a8ff') { throw 'Unexpected validation revision' }

$result = go test -count=1 -v -run '^TestConcurrentStatusReadsDoNotLoseWrites$' ./cmds/ownsand-agent/internal/store 2>&1; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $result | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $work 'windows-unelevated.log'); if ($code -ne 0 -or (($result | Out-String) -notmatch '--- SKIP: TestConcurrentStatusReadsDoNotLoseWrites' -or ($result | Out-String) -notmatch 'the test process is not an elevated administrator')) { throw 'Expected the explicit elevation skip' }

$result = go test -count=1 -v -run '^TestWriteFileAtomic(RetriesWhileReaderHoldsFile|GivesUpOnStuckReader)$' ./cmds/ownsand-agent/internal/store 2>&1; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $result | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $work 'windows-replacement-controls.log'); if ($code -ne 0 -or ($result | Out-String) -notmatch '--- PASS: TestWriteFileAtomicRetriesWhileReaderHoldsFile' -or ($result | Out-String) -notmatch '--- PASS: TestWriteFileAtomicGivesUpOnStuckReader') { throw 'Expected both unprivileged replacement controls to pass' }
expectedResults: TestConcurrentStatusReadsDoNotLoseWrites reports SKIP and “the test process is not an elevated administrator.” The command exits 0.
Both replacement controls pass on the Windows filesystem.

requiresElevation.reason: The available account is non-elevated. The store test needs an elevated administrator token to pass the gate and run its setup and assertions.
requiresElevation.setup: Use an elevated PowerShell session in an isolated checkout at the same revision. After creating the temporary directory, copy the probe source to files.copyTo. The negative case uses a Go overlay and leaves tracked files intact.
commands: if ((git rev-parse HEAD).Trim() -ne 'f192231ed52ab70854cde414b0ad1226e3d9a8ff') { throw 'Unexpected validation revision' }

$result = go test -count=1 -v -run '^TestConcurrentStatusReadsDoNotLoseWrites$' ./cmds/ownsand-agent/internal/store 2>&1; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $result | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $work 'windows-elevated.log'); if ($code -ne 0 -or ($result | Out-String) -notmatch '--- PASS: TestConcurrentStatusReadsDoNotLoseWrites') { throw 'Expected the elevated concurrency test to pass' }

$result = go test -count=1 -v -overlay $overlay -run '^TestConcurrentStatusReadsDoNotLoseWrites$' ./cmds/ownsand-agent/internal/store 2>&1; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $result | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $work 'windows-elevated-invalid-directory.log'); $log = $result | Out-String; if ($code -ne 1 -or $log -notmatch '--- FAIL: TestConcurrentStatusReadsDoNotLoseWrites' -or $log -notmatch 'open the store: store: create .*not-a-directory') { throw 'Expected a failing test with the store setup diagnostic' }
expectedResults: Normal setup passes the 300 writes, concurrent reader assertions, and final sequence check.
With a regular file supplied as the directory, the test reports FAIL and includes the wrapped store directory-creation error.
